chunks: You have been conveyed the Qur'an from One all-wise and all-knowing.
ai.seo_question: What does the Qur'an say about the source of its revelation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Naml underscores the Prophet's (peace be upon him) human reception of the divine message, distinguishing between his role as a recipient and Allah as the ultimate Source (Al-Hakim, Al-Alim). It reinforces the concept of Wahy as a direct transmission from the All-Wise, affirming the Qur'an's infallibility and the Prophet's trustworthiness (Amanah) in conveying it. This highlights the theological principle that while the Prophet is the vessel, the wisdom and knowledge originate solely from the Divine.
